AF-WCC-VAC-GEN.conclusion_text: For every admissible (s,delta) there is a comeager set G_{s,delta} of data such that for every data set in G_{s,delta}, the MGHD admits a conformal completion with a complete future null infinity I+ (all null generators complete), and no future-inextendible causal geodesic of finite affine length is visible from I+. Visibility uses the single-q TAIL predicate: gamma is visible from I+ iff there exist q in I+ and t0 in [0,T) such that the tail gamma([t0,T)) is contained in J^-(q) intersect M. This is a definition, not an asserted equivalence with any other formulation (review HF-06). The set-based reading (gamma contained in the union of J^-(q) over all q in I+) is strictly stronger; it is registered as variant `SET` of this class in the `variants:` block below and in artifacts/formulation/VARIANT_REGISTRY.json. It is NOT a separate class, and the two readings must never be interchanged.

The comeager quantifier is part of the statement and is bound before the data; 'generic' alone is not a readable substitute for it.
